mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, org_id, team_id, username, display_name, password_hash, user_type, status, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at, version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 2
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND username = #{username}

sql.if: AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.keyword}, '%') OR u.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.keyword}, '%'))

AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND ur.user_id = u.id AND r.role_code = #{filter.roleCode} AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' )

mapper.select:
SELECT u.id, u.tenant_id, u.org_id, u.team_id, u.username, u.display_name, u.user_type, u.status, u.last_login_at, u.created_at, u.updated_at, u.version, t.team_name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_team t ON t.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND t.id = u.team_id WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
ORDER BY u.id ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, team_name AS teamName FROM sys_team WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY team_name, id
SELECT id FROM sys_org WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_team WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{teamId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (tenant_id, org_id, team_id, username, display_name, password_hash, user_type, status) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{orgId}, #{teamId}, #{username}, #{displayName}, #{passwordHash}, #{userType}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET last_login_at = #{at} WHERE id = #{id}
